# Slime People
## General information
They breathe nitrogen instead of oxygen (though inhaling oxygen has no ill effect on them). They exhale nitrous oxide and are unaffected by inhaling it.
They have an internal 2x3 storage inventory inside of their slime membrane. This allows them to carry a bit more than other species, though unlike a backpack, [italic]anyone[/italic] is able to reach inside this inventory without asking.
Their "blood" is just slime, and therefore isn't replenished when metabolizing iron. Slime is moderately nutritious when consumed by other species, though drinking the blood of your coworkers is usually frowned upon.
Their metabolism processes up to six reagents at the same time, instead of only two.
They take [color=#1e90ff]40% less Blunt damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]20% less Poison damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]50% more Cold damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]20% more Slash damage[/color], and [color=#ffa500]20% more Piercing damage[/color].
They [color=#1e90ff]suffocate 80% slower[/color], but [color=#ffa500]take pressure damage 9% faster[/color]. This makes them by far the species capable of surviving the longest unprotected in a hard vacuum.
They take minor damage if their outer membranes come into contact with water or water vapor, though they can still consume water orally with no ill effect.
They have roughly [color=#1e90ff]double[/color] regeneration compared to other humanoids and can regenerate from far greater wounds up to [color=#1e90ff]triple[/color] compared to others.
